appraisal_events.evidence: Qu'est-ce que vous dites d'un savant comme cela ? ... Il n'y a pas moyen de causer sérieusement deux minutes avec lui.
appraisal_events.explanation: Mme Verdurin publicly mocks Cottard's attempted pun to the new guest Forcheville, dismissing his wit and manner in front of the table.

appraisal_events.evidence: Mme Verdurin qui, pâmant, les yeux fermés, précipita sa figure dans ses mains d'où s'échappèrent des cris étouffés.
appraisal_events.explanation: Brichot's erudite riposte provokes an exaggerated fit of laughter from the hostess, marking him as the salon's prized wit in contrast to Cottard's failed joke.

status_effects.explanation: His attempted pun is dismissed and he is openly mocked by the hostess in front of the desired new guest, marking him as socially maladroit in this scene.
His learned wordplay earns the hostess's most enthusiastic laughter and Forcheville's admiring attention, locally establishing him as the salon's star performer.
